changelog:
- Initial release with character portrait generation for TRPG rulebooks.
- Generates and embeds portraits for sample player characters, main NPCs, and key enemies into Excel character sheets.
- Ensures consistent art style based on the setting’s tone and world, with detailed style prompting and matching character descriptions.
- Only executes on explicit user request; will not generate portraits automatically.
- Saves images as PNGs in a designated folder and uses openpyxl to insert each portrait into its corresponding Excel sheet, auto-scaling as needed.
- Modifies the Excel sheet layout to allocate image space if not already reserved, without altering other data structures or formulas.
summary: Use this skill when generating character portraits for TRPG character sheets and embedding them into Excel files. Triggers on: generate character portraits,...
